authority: Root scientific policy explicitly permits selecting an original author-reported empirical predictive/method endpoint while retaining broader biological reproduction separately. Construction authorization is not execution or scientific qualification.
selected_scope: Complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset1 awake versus loss-of-responsiveness prediction under leave-one-subject-out evaluation over all 19 original participants. Reproduce the source random forest on the original18 integration/segregation features and compare candidates on identical source observations, state labels, windows, training selections and evaluation folds, retaining required source controls and companion ROC AUC.
source_figure_or_table: Figure 5b,c Dataset1 awake versus loss-of-responsiveness LOSO prediction

source_paper.title: Measuring the dynamic balance of integration and segregation underlying consciousness, anesthesia, and sleep in humans

strongest_relevant_author_comparator: Source random forest:100 trees to pure leaves and five randomly considered features per split. Reported balanced accuracy0.93 and companion AUC0.984 are rounded publication anchors; exact precision, ROC aggregation and calibrated native replay remain unresolved. A weaker rerun cannot lower the paper target.

target.description: Predict behaviorally assessed awake versus loss-of-responsiveness states for the complete original Figure 5b,c Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out result. This is an explicitly scoped paper result; transition-only and cross-dataset panels are separate original results and need not all be surpassed to claim this scope.

dataset.description: Use original Dataset-1 paired GSR/noGSR regional BOLD arrays from Figshare 26367193 version 1 for the declared Figure 5b,c result. Dataset-2 is required only for a separately predeclared source panel that uses it; Dataset-3/4/5 static contrasts do not substitute.

cohort.description: Retain all 19 original analyzed Dataset-1 subjects for the declared full LOSO panel. No easier subject/state/window subset may be selected after outcomes. A separately declared transfer or Dataset-2 panel must retain its complete original population, including all 26 Dataset-2 subjects where applicable.

split.description: Preserve original19-fold subject LOSO, stable baseline/deep-LOR excluding first and last five minutes/recovery training support, and20,000 randomly selected training points per class. Authenticate source sample/window identities or a documented source-protocol stochastic rerun with predeclared calibration and paired author/candidate draws. The exact non-overlapping-window semantics require recovery; pooled random-window or new nested splits are different tasks.

inputs.description: Original classifier inputs are18 integration/segregation features from whole brain and eight networks. Bind authentic awake/LOR labels and responsiveness times for all19 participants and each source evaluation window. These behavioral labels/times determine targets and training exclusions, not prediction features.

preprocessing.description: Preserve original 450-ROI extraction, Pearson dynamic connectivity in 4-minute windows stepping by one TR, and paired GSR/noGSR processing. Efficiency uses noGSR and clustering uses GSR, averaged over thresholds 0.01 through 1.00. Transition times and behavioral labels are targets, not predictor features.

metric.description: Balanced accuracy = (sensitivity + specificity)/2, higher is better; ROC AUC remains a separate reported endpoint. Static ISD and state-contrast significance are not classification accuracy.

aggregation.description: Preserve source mean balanced accuracy and SEM across all19 participants, with per-participant confusion counts and AUC/ROC companions. Source reports0.984 AUC, but whether the displayed mean ROC-curve AUC equals subject-macro AUC is unresolved; retain both representations separately until authenticated. No pooled-window mean or chosen participant subset may substitute.

previous_broader_scope.scope: The retained initial static integration, segregation and ISD state-contrast family in labeled sedation/sleep Datasets 3–5. Preserve original panel-specific participant and condition eligibility; the exact complete contrast panel and aggregation remain unresolved. Do not expand this scope to Dataset-1/2 temporal findings, HCP or every paper figure, and do not treat every released condition column as an original scored condition.
previous_broader_scope.interpretation: Original static integration, segregation and ISD state contrasts in Datasets3–5 remain separately named biological reproduction. Dataset2 transfer and transition-only prediction are separate original endpoints, not easier substitutes and not universal extra prerequisites for the selected complete Dataset1 panel.
